videoProtocol.startGate: A reviewed, accepted starting frame and fixed scene brief. If comparing video models directly, use one identical accepted frame across providers. Provider-specific accepted frames belong to a separately labelled end-to-end comparison; do not mix those conclusions.
videoProtocol.continuationGate: Confirm the interface performs native extension of the selected prior video. Asking chat for the next clip alone does not prove extension. Record exact parent ID, action, prompt and settings before each turn.
afterEveryTurn: Save provider/project/response/output IDs, prompt, settings, reported duration, inspection timestamps and concrete defects.
Inspect cumulative duration growth, retained earlier segment and seamless new join; distinguish a full cumulative result from suffix-only output, a rewrite, loop or retime.
Check identity, visible teeth/hoops/tattoos/jewelry, same four credits, hands, fixed camera/set, screen-right gauge and silent audio requirement.
Mark unavailable evidence unknown and stop; do not declare a native extension from duration metadata alone.
stopImmediatelyIf: The selected action produces a fresh independent clip or suffix-only result.
Earlier material changes, disappears, loops or is retimed instead of extended.
A critical visual continuity defect is observed.
The join, duration or retained prefix cannot be inspected.
Identity, props or set drift beyond the accepted brief.
Unexpected audio violates the silent plan.
A provider limit/error/paywall prevents the authorized operation or the ten-turn bound is reached.
videoProtocol.downloads: Keep evidence metadata every turn without bulk intermediate media downloads. Download only the final inspected cumulative output per provider when finished or stopped, if available; record bytes, SHA256, codec, dimensions, duration and retained failure reason. If browser inspection is insufficient, stop and report the evidence gap instead of blindly continuing.
videoProtocol.temporalScoring: Separate later scorecard for temporal identity/detail stability, prop persistence, motion/hands, join/prefix continuity, camera/composition and audio compliance. No temporal scores or accepted outputs exist at this checkpoint.
